summary.headline: The Planning Board voted to enter executive session regarding threatened litigation concerning 40-42 Central Street without returning to open session.
summary.summary: The Planning Board convened briefly on June 4, 2026, to conduct a roll call vote to enter executive session. The session was called under state open meeting law exemption 3 to discuss strategy regarding threatened litigation by the owner of 40-42 Central Street. The board did not reconvene in open session.

topics.title: Vote to enter executive session regarding 40-42 Central Street
topics.summary: The board voted by roll call to enter executive session to discuss legal strategy concerning threatened litigation from the owner of 40-42 Central Street. The chair declared that holding the discussion in open session would be detrimental to the town's position and noted the board would not return to open session.
key_details: Executive session convened under M.G.L. Chapter 30A, Section 21, exemption 3
Subject matter involves threatened litigation by the property owner of 40-42 Central Street
The board did not return to open session afterward

votes.motion: Enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding threatened litigation concerning 40-42 Central Street and not return to open session

summary.caveats: The recording covers only the open call to order and roll call vote to enter executive session, lasting under one minute. The substantive discussion occurred in closed executive session.
